integrity: Analytic proof establishes all integer sample sizes and real symmetric designs. Supplementary reproducibility code uses exact rational arithmetic; it is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for uniform integration on [-1,1], the rank-three Legendre polynomial kernel, centrally symmetric node multisets and eta>0. The source work's auxiliary-domain padding and asymptotic design conditions are not asserted; nonzero bias concerns the unmodified, unnormalized posterior-mean rule under a universal nonnegative-weight guarantee. Priority comparisons are bounded and independent audit is unperformed.
title: Sharp positivity frontier for three-feature Legendre Bayesian quadrature
